title: Joolie Health — patient information included in nursing template
reviewBasis: Repository schema, screens and API code; this is not verification of deployed production UI or individual patient records.
profileIntegrationGap: Patient-profile integration is outside this change. These fields save with the care-plan assessment and do not automatically synchronize with Client, insurance, intake, directives or eMAR records.
placementDecision: User requested inclusion of all listed items directly in the nursing template. All 37 requirement groups are mapped to concrete fields in the local draft.
